title: Fake videos of real people -- and how to spot them | Supasorn Suwajanakorn
speaker: TED

cues.text: Look at these images.
cues.en: Look at these images.
cues.zh: 看看這些影象。

cues.text: Now, tell me which Obama here is real.
cues.en: Now, tell me which Obama here is real.
cues.zh: 現在，告訴我這裡哪個歐巴馬是真的。

cues.text: Barack Obama: To help families refinance their homes, to invest in things like high-tech manufacturing,
cues.en: Barack Obama: To help families refinance their homes, to invest in things like high-tech manufacturing,
cues.zh: 巴拉克·歐巴馬：幫助家庭為房屋再融資、投資高科技製造業等

cues.text: clean energy and the infrastructure that creates good new jobs.
cues.en: clean energy and the infrastructure that creates good new jobs.
cues.zh: 清潔能源和創造良好新就業機會的基礎設施。

cues.text: Supasorn Suwajanakorn: Anyone?
cues.en: Supasorn Suwajanakorn: Anyone?
cues.zh: Supasorn Suwajanakorn：有人嗎？

cues.text: The answer is none of them.
cues.en: The answer is none of them.
cues.zh: 答案是沒有一個。

cues.text: None of these is actually real.
cues.en: None of these is actually real.
cues.zh: 這些都不是真實的。

cues.text: So let me tell you how we got here.
cues.en: So let me tell you how we got here.
cues.zh: 那麼讓我告訴你我們是如何到達這裡的。

cues.text: My inspiration for this work was a project meant to preserve our last chance for learning about the Holocaust
cues.en: My inspiration for this work was a project meant to preserve our last chance for learning about the Holocaust
cues.zh: 我對這項工作的靈感是一個旨在保留我們瞭解大屠殺的最後機會的專案

cues.text: from the survivors.
cues.en: from the survivors.
cues.zh: 來自倖存者。

cues.text: It's called New Dimensions in Testimony, and it allows you to have interactive conversations
cues.en: It's called New Dimensions in Testimony, and it allows you to have interactive conversations
cues.zh: 它被稱為證詞新維度，它允許您進行互動對話

cues.text: with a hologram of a real Holocaust survivor.
cues.en: with a hologram of a real Holocaust survivor.
cues.zh: 帶有真正的大屠殺倖存者的全息圖。

cues.text: Man: How did you survive the Holocaust?
cues.en: Man: How did you survive the Holocaust?
cues.zh: 男：你是怎麼在大屠殺中倖存的？

cues.text: Hologram: How did I survive?
cues.en: Hologram: How did I survive?
cues.zh: 全像圖：我是怎麼活下來的？

cues.text: I survived, I believe, because providence watched over me.
cues.en: I survived, I believe, because providence watched over me.
cues.zh: 我相信，我之所以能活下來，是因為上帝眷顧著我。

cues.text: SS: Turns out these answers were prerecorded in a studio.
cues.en: SS: Turns out these answers were prerecorded in a studio.
cues.zh: SS：原來這些答案是在錄音室預先錄製的。

cues.text: Yet the effect is astounding.
cues.en: Yet the effect is astounding.
cues.zh: 然而效果卻是驚人的。

cues.text: You feel so connected to his story and to him as a person.
cues.en: You feel so connected to his story and to him as a person.
cues.zh: 你會覺得自己與他的故事以及他這個人有著如此密切的連結。

cues.text: I think there's something special about human interaction that makes it much more profound
cues.en: I think there's something special about human interaction that makes it much more profound
cues.zh: 我認為人與人之間的互動有一些特別之處，使其更加深刻

cues.text: and personal than what books or lectures or movies could ever teach us.
cues.en: and personal than what books or lectures or movies could ever teach us.
cues.zh: 比書籍、講座或電影所能教導我們的更個人化。

cues.text: So I saw this and began to wonder, can we create a model like this for anyone?
cues.en: So I saw this and began to wonder, can we create a model like this for anyone?
cues.zh: 所以我看到這一點並開始想知道，我們可以為任何人建立這樣的模型嗎？

cues.text: A model that looks, talks and acts just like them?
cues.en: A model that looks, talks and acts just like them?
cues.zh: 一個外表、說話和行為都像他們的模特兒嗎？

cues.text: So I set out to see if this could be done and eventually came up with a new solution
cues.en: So I set out to see if this could be done and eventually came up with a new solution
cues.zh: 所以我開始看看是否可以做到這一點，並最終提出了一個新的解決方案

cues.text: that can build a model of a person using nothing but these: existing photos and videos of a person.
cues.en: that can build a model of a person using nothing but these: existing photos and videos of a person.
cues.zh: 它可以只使用以下內容來建立一個人的模型：一個人的現有照片和影片。

cues.text: If you can leverage this kind of passive information, just photos and video that are out there,
cues.en: If you can leverage this kind of passive information, just photos and video that are out there,
cues.zh: 如果你可以利用這種被動訊息，例如現有的照片和影片，

cues.text: that's the key to scaling to anyone.
cues.en: that's the key to scaling to anyone.
cues.zh: 這是向任何人擴充套件的關鍵。

cues.text: By the way, here's Richard Feynman, who in addition to being a Nobel Prize winner in physics
cues.en: By the way, here's Richard Feynman, who in addition to being a Nobel Prize winner in physics
cues.zh: 順便說一句，這是理查德·費曼，他不僅是諾貝爾物理學獎得主

cues.text: was also known as a legendary teacher.
cues.en: was also known as a legendary teacher.
cues.zh: 也稱為傳奇老師。

cues.text: Wouldn't it be great if we could bring him back to give his lectures and inspire millions of kids,
cues.en: Wouldn't it be great if we could bring him back to give his lectures and inspire millions of kids,
cues.zh: 如果我們能讓他回來演講並激勵數以百萬計的孩子，那不是很好嗎？

cues.text: perhaps not just in English but in any language?
cues.en: perhaps not just in English but in any language?
cues.zh: 也許不只是英語，而是任何語言？

cues.text: Or if you could ask our grandparents for advice and hear those comforting words
cues.en: Or if you could ask our grandparents for advice and hear those comforting words
cues.zh: 或者如果你可以向我們的祖父母尋求建議並聽到那些安慰的話

cues.text: even if they're no longer with us?
cues.en: even if they're no longer with us?
cues.zh: 即使他們不再和我們在一起？

cues.text: Or maybe using this tool, book authors, alive or not, could read aloud all of their books for anyone interested.
cues.en: Or maybe using this tool, book authors, alive or not, could read aloud all of their books for anyone interested.
cues.zh: 或者，也許使用這個工具，書籍作者，無論是否活著，都可以為任何有興趣的人大聲朗讀他們的所有書籍。

cues.text: The creative possibilities here are endless, and to me, that's very exciting.
cues.en: The creative possibilities here are endless, and to me, that's very exciting.
cues.zh: 這裡的創意可能性是無窮無盡的，對我來說，這非常令人興奮。

cues.text: And here's how it's working so far.
cues.en: And here's how it's working so far.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，它的運作方式如下。

cues.text: First, we introduce a new technique that can reconstruct a high-detailed 3D face model from any image
cues.en: First, we introduce a new technique that can reconstruct a high-detailed 3D face model from any image
cues.zh: 首先，我們介紹一種新技術，可以從任何影像重建高細節的 3D 人臉模型

cues.text: without ever 3D-scanning the person.
cues.en: without ever 3D-scanning the person.
cues.zh: 無需對人進行 3D 掃描。

cues.text: And here's the same output model from different views.
cues.en: And here's the same output model from different views.
cues.zh: 這是不同檢視下的相同輸出模型。

cues.text: This also works on videos, by running the same algorithm on each video frame
cues.en: This also works on videos, by running the same algorithm on each video frame
cues.zh: 這也適用於影片，透過在每個影片幀上執行相同的演演算法

cues.text: and generating a moving 3D model.
cues.en: and generating a moving 3D model.
cues.zh: 並產生移動的 3D 模型。

cues.text: And here's the same output model from different angles.
cues.en: And here's the same output model from different angles.
cues.zh: 這是不同角度的相同輸出模型。

cues.text: It turns out this problem is very challenging, but the key trick is that we are going to analyze
cues.en: It turns out this problem is very challenging, but the key trick is that we are going to analyze
cues.zh: 事實證明這個問題非常具有挑戰性，但關鍵在於我們要分析

cues.text: a large photo collection of the person beforehand.
cues.en: a large photo collection of the person beforehand.
cues.zh: 事先收集該人的大量照片。

cues.text: For George W. Bush, we can just search on Google, and from that, we are able to build an average model,
cues.en: For George W. Bush, we can just search on Google, and from that, we are able to build an average model,
cues.zh: 對於喬治·W·布什，我們可以在谷歌上搜尋，然後我們可以建立一個平均模型，

cues.text: an iterative, refined model to recover the expression in fine details, like creases and wrinkles.
cues.en: an iterative, refined model to recover the expression in fine details, like creases and wrinkles.
cues.zh: 一個迭代的、精緻的模型，用於恢復精細細節的表達，例如摺痕和皺紋。

cues.text: What's fascinating about this is that the photo collection can come from your typical photos.
cues.en: What's fascinating about this is that the photo collection can come from your typical photos.
cues.zh: 令人著迷的是，照片集可以來自您的典型照片。

cues.text: It doesn't really matter what expression you're making or where you took those photos.
cues.en: It doesn't really matter what expression you're making or where you took those photos.
cues.zh: 你做出什麼表情或在哪裡拍攝這些照片並不重要。

cues.text: What matters is that there are a lot of them.
cues.en: What matters is that there are a lot of them.
cues.zh: 重要的是它們的數量很多。

cues.text: And we are still missing color here, so next, we develop a new blending technique
cues.en: And we are still missing color here, so next, we develop a new blending technique
cues.zh: 我們這裡仍然缺少顏色，所以接下來，我們開發一種新的混合技術

cues.text: that improves upon a single averaging method and produces sharp facial textures and colors.
cues.en: that improves upon a single averaging method and produces sharp facial textures and colors.
cues.zh: 它改進了單一平均方法並產生清晰的臉部紋理和顏色。

cues.text: And this can be done for any expression.
cues.en: And this can be done for any expression.
cues.zh: 這可以對任何表示式進行。

cues.text: Now we have a control of a model of a person, and the way it's controlled now is by a sequence of static photos.
cues.en: Now we have a control of a model of a person, and the way it's controlled now is by a sequence of static photos.
cues.zh: 現在我們可以控制一個人的模型，現在控制它的方式是透過一系列靜態照片。

cues.text: Notice how the wrinkles come and go, depending on the expression.
cues.en: Notice how the wrinkles come and go, depending on the expression.
cues.zh: 注意皺紋如何出現和消失，取決於表情。

cues.text: We can also use a video to drive the model.
cues.en: We can also use a video to drive the model.
cues.zh: 我們也可以使用視訊來驅動模型。

cues.text: Daniel Craig: Right, but somehow, we've managed to attract some more amazing people.
cues.en: Daniel Craig: Right, but somehow, we've managed to attract some more amazing people.
cues.zh: 丹尼爾克雷格：是的，但不知何故，我們設法吸引了一些更出色的人。

cues.text: SS: And here's another fun demo.
cues.en: SS: And here's another fun demo.
cues.zh: SS：這是另一個有趣的演示。

cues.text: So what you see here are controllable models of people I built from their internet photos.
cues.en: So what you see here are controllable models of people I built from their internet photos.
cues.zh: 所以你在這裡看到的是我根據他們的網路照片建立的可控模型。

cues.text: Now, if you transfer the motion from the input video, we can actually drive the entire party.
cues.en: Now, if you transfer the motion from the input video, we can actually drive the entire party.
cues.zh: 現在，如果您從輸入視訊傳輸運動，我們實際上可以驅動整個聚會。

cues.text: George W. Bush: It's a difficult bill to pass, because there's a lot of moving parts,
cues.en: George W. Bush: It's a difficult bill to pass, because there's a lot of moving parts,
cues.zh: 喬治·W·布希：這是一項很難透過的法案，因為有很多變化的部分，

cues.text: and the legislative processes can be ugly.
cues.en: and the legislative processes can be ugly.
cues.zh: 而且立法程式可能很醜。

cues.text: SS: So coming back a little bit, our ultimate goal, rather, is to capture their mannerisms
cues.en: SS: So coming back a little bit, our ultimate goal, rather, is to capture their mannerisms
cues.zh: SS：所以回來一點，我們的最終目標是捕捉他們的行為

cues.text: or the unique way each of these people talks and smiles.
cues.en: or the unique way each of these people talks and smiles.
cues.zh: 或這些人每個人說話和微笑的獨特方式。

cues.text: So to do that, can we actually teach the computer to imitate the way someone talks
cues.en: So to do that, can we actually teach the computer to imitate the way someone talks
cues.zh: 為此，我們真的可以教電腦模仿某人說話的方式嗎

cues.text: by only showing it video footage of the person?
cues.en: by only showing it video footage of the person?
cues.zh: 只顯示該人的影片片段？

cues.text: And what I did exactly was, I let a computer watch 14 hours of pure Barack Obama giving addresses.
cues.en: And what I did exactly was, I let a computer watch 14 hours of pure Barack Obama giving addresses.
cues.zh: 我所做的就是讓電腦觀看 14 小時純粹的巴拉克·奧巴馬 (Barack Obama) 演講。

cues.text: And here's what we can produce given only his audio.
cues.en: And here's what we can produce given only his audio.
cues.zh: 以下是我們僅根據他的音訊即可製作的內容。

cues.text: BO: The results are clear.
cues.en: BO: The results are clear.
cues.zh: BO：結果很明顯。

cues.text: America's businesses have created 14.5 million new jobs
cues.en: America's businesses have created 14.5 million new jobs
cues.zh: 美國企業創造了1450萬個新就業機會

cues.text: over 75 straight months.
cues.en: over 75 straight months.
cues.zh: 連續超過 75 個月。

cues.text: SS: So what's being synthesized here is only the mouth region, and here's how we do it.
cues.en: SS: So what's being synthesized here is only the mouth region, and here's how we do it.
cues.zh: SS：所以這裡合成的只是嘴部區域，這就是我們的做法。

cues.text: Our pipeline uses a neural network to convert and input audio into these mouth points.
cues.en: Our pipeline uses a neural network to convert and input audio into these mouth points.
cues.zh: 我們的管道使用神經網路將音訊轉換並輸入到這些口點中。

cues.text: BO: We get it through our job or through Medicare or Medicaid.
cues.en: BO: We get it through our job or through Medicare or Medicaid.
cues.zh: BO：我們透過工作或醫療保險或醫療補助獲得它。

cues.text: SS: Then we synthesize the texture, enhance details and teeth, and blend it into the head and background from a source video.
cues.en: SS: Then we synthesize the texture, enhance details and teeth, and blend it into the head and background from a source video.
cues.zh: SS：然後我們合成紋理，增強細節和牙齒，並將其融合到來源影片的頭部和背景中。

cues.text: BO: Women can get free checkups, and you can't get charged more just for being a woman.
cues.en: BO: Women can get free checkups, and you can't get charged more just for being a woman.
cues.zh: BO：女性可以得到免費檢查，而且不能因為是女性而收取更多費用。

cues.text: Young people can stay on a parent's plan until they turn 26.
cues.en: Young people can stay on a parent's plan until they turn 26.
cues.zh: 年輕人可以繼續享受父母的計劃，直到年滿 26 歲。

cues.text: SS: I think these results seem very realistic and intriguing, but at the same time frightening, even to me.
cues.en: SS: I think these results seem very realistic and intriguing, but at the same time frightening, even to me.
cues.zh: SS：我認為這些結果看起來非常現實和有趣，但同時也令人恐懼，即使對我來說也是如此。

cues.text: Our goal was to build an accurate model of a person, not to misrepresent them.
cues.en: Our goal was to build an accurate model of a person, not to misrepresent them.
cues.zh: 我們的目標是建立一個準確的人模型，而不是歪曲他們。

cues.text: But one thing that concerns me is its potential for misuse.
cues.en: But one thing that concerns me is its potential for misuse.
cues.zh: 但令我擔心的一件事是它可能被濫用。

cues.text: People have been thinking about this problem for a long time, since the days when Photoshop first hit the market.
cues.en: People have been thinking about this problem for a long time, since the days when Photoshop first hit the market.
cues.zh: 從 Photoshop 首次上市以來，人們長期以來一直在思考這個問題。

cues.text: As a researcher, I'm also working on countermeasure technology,
cues.en: As a researcher, I'm also working on countermeasure technology,
cues.zh: 身為研究員，我也在研究對策技術，

cues.text: and I'm part of an ongoing effort at AI Foundation, which uses a combination of machine learning and human moderators
cues.en: and I'm part of an ongoing effort at AI Foundation, which uses a combination of machine learning and human moderators
cues.zh: 我是人工智慧基金會持續努力的一部分，該基金會結合了機器學習和人類主持人

cues.text: to detect fake images and videos, fighting against my own work.
cues.en: to detect fake images and videos, fighting against my own work.
cues.zh: 檢測虛假影象和影片，與我自己的作品作鬥爭。

cues.text: And one of the tools we plan to release is called Reality Defender, which is a web-browser plug-in that can flag potentially fake content
cues.en: And one of the tools we plan to release is called Reality Defender, which is a web-browser plug-in that can flag potentially fake content
cues.zh: 我們計劃發布的工具之一稱為 Reality Defender，它是一個網頁瀏覽器外掛，可以標記潛在的虛假內容

cues.text: automatically, right in the browser.
cues.en: automatically, right in the browser.
cues.zh: 自動，就在瀏覽器中。

cues.text: Despite all this, though, fake videos could do a lot of damage, even before anyone has a chance to verify,
cues.en: Despite all this, though, fake videos could do a lot of damage, even before anyone has a chance to verify,
cues.zh: 儘管如此，假影片可能會造成很大的損害，甚至在任何人有機會驗證之前，

cues.text: so it's very important that we make everyone aware of what's currently possible
cues.en: so it's very important that we make everyone aware of what's currently possible
cues.zh: 因此，讓每個人都瞭解當前可能發生的事情非常重要

cues.text: so we can have the right assumption and be critical about what we see.
cues.en: so we can have the right assumption and be critical about what we see.
cues.zh: 這樣我們就可以有正確的假設並對我們所看到的東西進行批判。

cues.text: There's still a long way to go before we can fully model individual people
cues.en: There's still a long way to go before we can fully model individual people
cues.zh: 在我們能夠完全建模個人之前還有很長的路要走

cues.text: and before we can ensure the safety of this technology.
cues.en: and before we can ensure the safety of this technology.
cues.zh: 在我們能夠確保這項技術的安全性之前。

cues.text: But I'm excited and hopeful, because if we use it right and carefully,
cues.en: But I'm excited and hopeful, because if we use it right and carefully,
cues.zh: 但我感到興奮和充滿希望，因為如果我們正確而謹慎地使用它，

cues.text: this tool can allow any individual's positive impact on the world
cues.en: this tool can allow any individual's positive impact on the world
cues.zh: 這個工具可以讓任何個人對世界產生正面影響

cues.text: to be massively scaled and really help shape our future the way we want it to be.
cues.en: to be massively scaled and really help shape our future the way we want it to be.
cues.zh: 大規模擴充套件並真正幫助我們以我們想要的方式塑造未來。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
